name: Can we live in our home during a whole-house renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can we live in our home during a whole-house renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can stay depends on the scope of structural changes, utility access, and personal tolerance for construction activity. In a comprehensive whole-house overhaul that addresses the kitchen, primary bathrooms, and structural walls simultaneously, homeowners frequently choose off-site accommodations. Critical utilities like water, heating, and power often experience planned shutoffs during rough-in electrical and plumbing phases. If remodeling occurs in distinct phases or primarily targets separate levels such as a basement, staying on-site may remain manageable, though homeowners should prepare for daily dust, active work crews, and limited living zones.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living on-site depends on project scope; complete overhauls affecting kitchens, utilities, and main bathrooms usually require temporary relocation during heavy construction.
